pages.title: Held-Item Selectors
pages.text: For server-player selectors that inspect $(thing)SelectedItem$(), Auram first tests the live held stack. A mismatch, or a predicate containing only that field, can avoid full player/capability serialization.$(br2)Empty hands, non-player entities and successful tests needing other root fields retain the full serialization path. No stale NBT snapshot is cached.

pages.title: Tom’s Storage IDs
pages.text: Tom’s Storage already looks up an item’s packet ID. Auram reuses that known nonzero ID during the same packet entry instead of repeating a capability-heavy lookup.$(br2)New entries, zero IDs and custom maps retain the original path. Quantities, packet splitting and large-NBT fallback remain part of Tom’s Storage.
